utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so the repair drive is actually still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — I haven’t heard any change to that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, good call — I might swing by too if I remember. Let me know when you’re heading over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know when I’m heading over, and I’ll remind the others too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you help by spreading the word and collecting any small repair items folks want to donate?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I can spread the word and start collecting small repair items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of strong flashlights. If you can bring any of that, it’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring screws and duct tape today, and I’ll look for a couple of strong flashlights too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair drive details so you can coordinate around pickup. Thanks for jumping in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send them when you can and I’ll work around pickup. I’m happy to help once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m glad you brought it up; I’ve been meaning to check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll write down the remaining fixes, and we can go through them one by one. Then we’ll know exactly what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia — the repair drive is this Saturday, and everyone’s welcome. If you want, I can save you a spot and send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help — can you send me the time and where to drop things off? I just want to make sure I’ve got the logistics right.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts at 10 a.m. at the community center, and you can drop items off at the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming up, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing — we’re gathering tools and supplies for small home repairs, and folks can drop off or request help at the community center this week. I’ll make sure you get the schedule and sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for the schedule and sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off at the community center this afternoon, and they’re especially looking for tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s good to know — I can swing by the community center this afternoon and drop off a few spare parts if they’re still collecting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That should be perfect — just check with the center when you get there so you know they’re still taking them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me the time and what needs fixing, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be there a bit late, around 3:30, and I can help with the loose fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is being held, so I can point you to the right place. If you want, I can check the exact location for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a hammer and some screwdrivers I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: 3:30 works for me. I’ll bring a few tools and we’ll get that fence panel sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll double-check the details before I commit to anything. What do we know about the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just that it’s for repairs, and I’m still waiting on the full details. I’d rather not guess before Opal confirms everything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand — if you need a wrench or a drill for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a bit with the repair drive, though I’m keeping things low-key these days.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if we run short.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should pin down the timing and what supplies are needed first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm what time works best and what supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do late morning, if that works, and I’d like to know exactly what tools and replacement parts we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—want me to check who’s available and what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please—could you check who’s available and what tasks still need doing? That would really help us keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s free and what’s left on the list, then I’ll report back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I usually end up arriving late, so I appreciate you keeping tabs on it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem — I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are dropping things off all afternoon. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll let you know if they need extra hands or if the drop-off times change.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m in. Just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send you the repair drive details now, and if anything’s unclear, just flag it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send them over and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — I’ve got a hammer and a set of screwdrivers you can borrow. Swing by when you’re ready, and I’ll get them for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — I’ll swing by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll be around, so just knock when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking we should get the repair drive moving soon — I can spread the word to a few neighbors if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, so a little help spreading the word would really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few folks today and make sure they know the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have anything noted yet, but I can help track where the repair drive is happening. Want me to check the location details with you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please—let’s keep it simple. Tell me where it’s happening and what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s happening at the community center parking lot, and be there by 10:00 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m still checking the details on the repair drive, so I don’t want to guess yet. If you have the latest list of needed items, send it over and I’ll compare it with what’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the latest list yet, but I can check for it and send it over. If you want, I can also ask around about what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll do my part too and keep you posted if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Oren — I’ll check back in if I hear anything while I’m out.
